prompts.prompt: When you containerize an ASP.NET Core app starting with .NET 8, what non-root HTTP port does Kestrel listen on by default inside the container? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/backend/skills/aspnet-core/SKILL.md - Docker default port changed to 8080 in .NET 8 (non-root). Use ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS=8080.

prompts.prompt: For a project on the .NET 10 LTS release of ASP.NET Core, in what year does that release reach end of support? Answer concisely.
In ASP.NET Core dependency injection, is it safe practice to inject a Scoped or Transient service directly into a Singleton service? Answer in one sentence.
prompts.source: plugins/backend/skills/aspnet-core/SKILL.md - Captive dependency trap: never inject Scoped/Transient into Singleton -- the short-lived service gets captured for the app's lifetime.
